latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Editor for YouTube skill.
- Allows users to upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and edit it using AI automation on cloud GPUs.
- Supports fast 1080p MP4 exports (1-2 minutes for typical videos), with all processing done server-side.
- Handles uploads, editing requests, export, credit checks, and session management via a dedicated backend API.
- Automatic error handling for common issues like expired tokens, unsupported files, or insufficient credits.
- Designed specifically for YouTube-focused workflows, including timeline editing, silences removal, transitions, and batch processing.
